answer: The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the zephyr queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1077 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the horizon. A farm of 251 pays that 189 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
